Now, with Describe a Shortcut, you can automate daily tasks with a simple description. Just describe what you need, and Shortcuts creates an automation that connects actions across apps.

Choose from hundreds of built-in actions in your favorite apps — like Calendar, Camera, Reminders, and more — to help you accomplish everyday tasks with a simple tap from the Home Screen, by asking Siri, or even automatically.

Use the Shortcuts app to:

	•	Add a Home Screen icon that calls a loved one
	•	Make animated GIFs
	•	Make PDFs from Safari

And so much more...
